The completeness test now passes alone, the fake derives its resolved config, and chrF, the corpus aggregation, the join, byte-unchanged corpus, alignatt record and schema stand. Five findings, all outside the criteria; the only material one is that the --config help still says JSON object while the flag reads a path.
